messages:
maria-g: FYI we have a BlueHaven private pool ondedicated capacity that's seeing repeat 429s during morning spike. Customers reporting token/s SLO violations and high latency. Looks like admission is dropping to reject + burst credits gone. Can someone triage?
jay: On it. Do we have the pool id and recent admission logs?
maria-g: Pool=ph-private-04, account=bluehaven, started ~08:12 UTC, spike ended ~08:28 but reoccurred at 09:05. Reported error: 429 + body: "quota_exceeded: burst credits exhausted".
opsbot: Alert: [admission] ph-private-04 reject-rate=34% window=5m tps_in=420 target_slo=200 :warning:
anika: That's a lot. Quick questions: is autoscale failing to spin up nodes or is admission deliberately rejecting because headroom policy bottomed?
taylor: Looking at autoscaler events: recent scale-up triggered at 08:14 but new nodes failed to register due to kube CNI flakiness. See excerpt: ```Event: FailedCreatePod: network plugin not ready```
jay: So autoscale tried but nodes never joined. Meanwhile admission controller kept draining tokens then switched to reject mode. Need logs from admission-controller for pool. Anika, can you pull last 30s debug?
anika: grabbing logs... ```[2024-05-09T08:12:34Z] admission: pool=ph-private-04 tokens=0 headroom_pct=0 reject=true reason=BURST_CREDITS_EXHAUSTED account=bluehaven```
anika: Also found `admission.replenish` jobs failing with 503 when calling billing-api at same time: ```POST /accounts/bluehaven/burst/refill -> 503 ServiceUnavailable```
maria-g: So two issues: billing refill failing (no credits) + autoscale node join failure. That explains reject behavior. Any quick mitigations?
jay: Short term: manual refill of burst credits and a temporary increase of admission headroom for the pool (so we accept slightly higher concurrency while infra recovers). I'll request refill now.
opsbot: Command run: `rb_admin refill-burst --account bluehaven --amount 100000 --by support` -> status=queued (CS-8591).
sre-bot: Autoscale event: 3 nodes attempted, 2 failed to join due to CNI timeouts. Kube team notified.
anika: After queued refill, billing API retries succeeded at 08:19 and admission shows tokens refilled. Log: ```[2024-05-09T08:20:01Z] admission: pool=ph-private-04 tokens=150000 headroom_pct=10 reject=false reason=REFILLED```
taylor: Good. Confirming request acceptance rate climbed and 429s dropped to normal within ~30s. But we still saw latency spikes because KV cache warms.
jay: Action items: 1) SRE to investigate CNI flakiness causing node join failures (assign to taylor). 2) Support to document temporary refill and notify BlueHaven (maria). 3) Product ops to consider adjusting default headroom policy for private pools with critical accounts (anika).
anika: I'll open follow-up ticket PROD-1247 to evaluate default headroom.
maria-g: I'll notify BlueHaven support rep and share timeline + root cause: autoscaler node join failure + transient billing endpoint outage.
opsbot: Note: created ticket CS-8591 for manual refill and PROD-1247 for policy review.
jay: For repro steps (so eng can run locally): 1) simulate tps spike to 450 on pool ph-private-04 2) block billing API endpoint to force refill failure 3) cause 1 node join failure by injecting CNI delay -> expect admission rejects and burst drain. Example load command: ```hey -n 10000 -c 200 http://private-gw/predict -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"input":"x"}'```
taylor: Will take node join logs and open infra bug INFRA-6789.
anika: For RCA doc: please include timestamps, autoscaler events, billing-api latency graph, admission controller logs, and suggested SLO/Headroom change.
maria-g: Thanks everyone. I'll draft message to customer and close once infra bug confirmed fixed. :white_check_mark:
